topic: Assess SwiftCart delivery growth, reliability and costs.

snippets.text: The fictional delivery company SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries in 2025, up from 800,000 in 2024. Its on-time delivery rate rose from 90% to 92%.
SwiftCart's average cost per delivery rose from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025. Higher fuel and labour costs were cited in its fictional annual report.
The same 2025 online grocery survey found that 360 of 600 online buyers valued delivery reliability most. The survey did not ask respondents to rank every purchasing factor.

draft_memo.title: SwiftCart Delivery Assessment
draft_memo.body:
In 2025, SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries, an increase from 800,000 deliveries in 2024, marking a growth of 25% over the year [P05]. The company's on-time delivery rate improved from 90% in 2024 to 92% in 2025, reflecting a 2 percentage point increase in reliability [P05]. A survey indicated that 360 out of 600 online buyers prioritized delivery reliability as the most important factor in their purchasing decisions, highlighting the significance of this metric in consumer preferences [P08]. However, the survey did not require respondents to rank all purchasing factors, which limits the understanding of overall customer preferences and the relative importance of delivery reliability compared to other factors [P08]. 

Despite the growth in delivery volume and reliability, SwiftCart's average cost per delivery increased from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025, representing an 8% rise [P06]. The annual report attributed this increase to higher fuel and labor costs, which are critical factors affecting operational expenses [P06]. The average cost per delivery is measured in credits and reflects the total expenses incurred for each delivery made by the company, including labor and fuel costs [P06]. This measurement is essential for evaluating the financial performance of the delivery operations. 

The data does not cover customer satisfaction levels or the impact of cost increases on customer retention, which are important for a comprehensive assessment of SwiftCart's performance [P08]. Furthermore, the survey's limited scope and the exclusion of certain costs in the analysis restrict the overall understanding of the delivery service's effectiveness and customer perceptions [P08].
footnotes: [P05] SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries in 2025, up from 800,000 in 2024, with an on-time delivery rate rising from 90% to 92%.
[P06] SwiftCart's average cost per delivery rose from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025, attributed to higher fuel and labor costs.
[P08] A survey found that 360 of 600 online buyers valued delivery reliability most, but did not ask respondents to rank every purchasing factor.

reasons: The sentence 'This measurement is essential for evaluating the financial performance of the delivery operations.' does not have an inline citation, violating the claims cited criterion.
